method_status_notes: No single vendor-canonical protein MHP package frozen here; Fauchère-style exponential MLP on FreeSASA SAS points with Fauchère–Pliska π is literature-supported and fully specified target-blind.

method.name: Molecular Lipophilicity / Hydrophobicity Potential (Fauchère exponential MLP)

primary_paper.title: A new approach to structure-activity relations: the "molecular lipophilicity potential"
primary_paper.authors: Audry E; Dubost JP; Colleter JC; Dallet P
primary_paper.notes: Foundational MLP note; no stable DOI found in publisher records — cite via journal volume/pages. Related Audry 1989 DOI 10.1016/0223-5234(89)90109-8.

related_mlp_paper_with_doi.title: Application of molecular lipophilicity potential to a series of β-adrenolytic amines

parameter_paper.title: Hydrophobic parameters π of amino-acid side chains from the partitioning of N-acetyl-amino-acid amides
parameter_paper.journal: Eur J Med Chem Chim Ther 18:369-375

method.software: FreeSASA (Lee–Richards SAS) + in-house Fauchère MLP field

surface.algorithm: FreeSASA LeeRichards atomic SASA + deterministic Fibonacci SAS-sphere sampling on heavy atoms
surface.hydrogens: IGNORED (heavy atoms only; no protonation for HYDRO surface)
surface.point_keep_rule: point on sphere radius (r_vdw+probe) kept if outside all other atoms' (r_vdw+probe-0.05)

hydrophobic_field.formula: H(s) = sum_i f_i * exp(-alpha * ||s - x_i||) for heavy atoms i with ||s-x_i|| <= cutoff
hydrophobic_field.f_i_assignment: residue-level Fauchère–Pliska π applied to every heavy atom of that residue
hydrophobic_field.kernel_source: Fauchère exponential e^{-d} as used in MLP implementations (e.g. ChimeraX mlp method=fauchere)

patch.area_per_vertex: equal weight 1/N_surface (fraction features); absolute area proxy = n_vertices (not Å²-calibrated)

cdr: IMGT via cdr_sequence_index_imgt.csv; CDR vertices = nearest residue sequence index is CDR
anti_posthoc: Do not retune alpha/cutoff/quantile/scale after target scoring; any change => HYDRO-FIELD_v2_POSTHOC
